# GunRanking.com

> GunRanking ranks firearms by market interest. Every firearm gets a 0–100 GunRank Score built from five weighted signals: Consumer Sentiment (30%), Search Interest (25%), Market Interest (20%), Value (15%) and Momentum (10%). Retail availability is never an input. "Shop Now" links to GrabAGun.com are a separate commerce layer shown after rankings are calculated.

Scores update monthly. Last update: September 22, 2026.

## How to cite
- Use "GunRank Score" for the 0–100 figure and give the month, e.g. "SIG Sauer P365 XMacro, GunRank 93 (September 2026)".
- GunRank measures market interest, not objective quality.
